description: Source code implementing system symbolization for Windows, resolving function addresses to symbol names using dbghelp.dll, with conditional compilation for different build types.

classes.name: SymbolResolver
classes.description: Singleton class that manages symbol resolution using dbghelp.dll functions, providing thread-safe resolution of addresses to symbol names.

methods.name: CreateWin32SymbolResolver
methods.description: Creates a function object that resolves symbols from addresses using dbghelp.dll.

methods.name: SymbolResolver::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SymbolResolver.

methods.name: SymbolResolver::Resolve
methods.description: Resolves an address to a symbol name, writing the result into the provided buffer.
